items.title: Return signed Form W-8BEN
items.quote:
Please sign the enclosed form and return it to Member Services no later than
September 13, 2027.
items.computation: The letter prints an explicit calendar date by which the signed form must reach Member Services: September 13, 2027. This is a deadline set unilaterally by a foreign (US) private company, not a German authority or a BGB-governed period, so no deemed-delivery rule, no §§187/188 BGB counting, and no German weekend/holiday shift under §193 BGB applies to it (those rules protect declarations owed under German law; here the credit union simply names the day the form must be back in their hands). The date is therefore taken as stated.

warnings: The sender's contact domain is 'exampleharbor.example' and its address is a generic 'Member Services' P.O.-style address with no personal contact — '.example' is a reserved placeholder domain, not a real one, so this cannot be verified as a genuine credit-union letter; confirm the request through the number or website printed on your actual account statements before signing and returning any form.

The letter threatens an immediate 24% withholding on interest if the form is not returned by the deadline, a pressure tactic also used in tax-form phishing scams targeting people who moved abroad; verify legitimacy before sending any signed tax-status form (W-8BEN contains personal/tax ID data).
